# Inspector E2E mock MCP server

Standalone [FastMCP](https://gofastmcp.com/) streamable-HTTP server for Playwright and local `yarn e2e`.

## Endpoints

| URL | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `http://127.0.0.1:8765/health` | Liveness probe (`200`, body `ok`) |
| `http://127.0.0.1:8765/mcp` | MCP streamable HTTP |

## Tools

All tools return deterministic **plain text** in MCP `content` (mapped in the agent as `result.content`):

- `resolve-library-id` → `mock-resolve-library-id:/mock/{libraryName}`
- `get-library-docs` → `mock-get-library-docs:{libraryName}:{topic}`
- `ask_question` → `mock-ask_question:{repoName}:{question}`
- `read_wiki_structure` → `mock-read_wiki_structure:{repoName}`
- `read_wiki_contents` → `mock-read_wiki_contents:{repoName}:{page}`

## Run

From the repo root with the project venv active:

```bash
python rasa/core/channels/inspector-nextgen/e2e/mock-mcp/server.py
```

`yarn e2e` starts this process automatically and waits for `/health` before `rasa inspect`.
